description: This file contains the implementation of a PostgreSQL 6.4 driver class (`ADODB_postgres64`) and related recordset class (`ADORecordSet_postgres64`) for the ADOdb database abstraction layer in PHP. It defines methods for database connection, query execution, transaction management, metadata retrieval, blob handling, and type mapping specifically tailored for PostgreSQL version 6.4.

classes.name: ADODB_postgres64
classes.description: Driver class for PostgreSQL 6.4, managing connection, query execution, and metadata.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves server version and description details.

methods.name: pg_insert_id
methods.description: Gets last insert ID based on sequence.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves list of tables and views.

methods.name: qStr
methods.description: Quotes a string for safe SQL inclusion.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Generates SQL to format date columns.

methods.name: UpdateBlobFile
methods.description: Loads a large object from a file into the database as a blob.

methods.name: BlobDelete
methods.description: Deletes a blob from the database.

methods.name: BlobDecode
methods.description: Decodes a blob fetched from database.

methods.name: BlobEncode
methods.description: Encodes binary data for database storage.

methods.name: UpdateBlob
methods.description: Updates blob data in the database.

methods.name: OffsetDate
methods.description: Generates SQL for date offset calculations.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_postgres64
classes.description: Recordset class for handling query results from PostgreSQL 6.4, including blob handling.

methods.name: GetRowAssoc
methods.description: Returns current row as associative array.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Retrieves field value by name or index.

methods.name: _prepFields
methods.description: Prepares fields, decodes blobs if present.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Maps field type to internal type.
